title: Voyah recreated Mercedes’ upside-down tunnel ad, then launched the car for $33,800
summary: Dongfeng’s Voyah launched the Passion S electric SUV on Friday after promoting it with a stunt in which the car drove a full loop around a tunnel ceiling in Wuhan.
